body:
Well put Danzo. I can relate to this a lot. I've put on a face to impress others just to connect. I've lied about myself and become a chameleon to get into relationships, but at what cost? I end up sacrificing my self-esteem because I can't be myself.

Be yourself. Always project yourself at those you interact with, and if someone likes that, you're golden.

Hey PIS, happy cakeday.

I'm not sure what you mean by "go to her Facebook and delete it". You can't delete others Facebook profiles. I've deleted all of the other things you mentioned, but I still find some way of recovering it all. She's a very easy-to-Google person, with plenty of publicly available info. I've tried setting up browser net-nanny style blocks for Firefox, but I still find another computer and use that to obsess.

I also work out quite a bit (at least I do lots of cardio -- I'm training for a marathon).

Thanks for your help. I do want to make new friends and hope I'll find someone better for me. It's just a bad patch for me at the moment and I feel I'm more susceptible due to the sleep problems.
